## Technical Stack & Capabilities
- **Frontend Frameworks**: React 18, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, Three.js / WebGL
- **Backend & Database Systems**: Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Django), Rust, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis
- **Mobile Development**: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin
- **Desktop & Offline Software**: Electron, Tauri, SQLite local embedded caching
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Vercel, Cloudflare, CI/CD automated pipelines

## Service Portfolio
1. **Custom Web Application Development**: High-scale enterprise web apps, client portals, internal dashboards, and real-time collaboration tools.
2. **Offline-First Point of Sale (POS)**: Industry-specific software designed to operate without Internet interruption with automated sync on reconnection.
3. **Mobile App Engineering**: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with native device integration and offline persistence.
4. **SaaS Architecture & Development**: Turnkey SaaS platforms with multi-tenant tenancy, subscription billing, and user management.
5. **3D Web Experiences & WebGL**: Interactive 3D product visualizers, architectural tile calculators, and spatial landing pages.
6. **UI/UX & Brand Design**: Full design systems, typography hierarchy, high-conversion dark-mode interfaces, and interactive Figma prototypes.
7. **Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals**: International SEO architecture, structured data schemas, crawl budget optimization, and sub-second page loads.
8. **WordPress & Headless CMS**: Custom theme development, WooCommerce customization, and decoupled headless architectures.
